whatIs: TanStack is a family of libraries for web applications, with framework-agnostic cores and adapters for React, Vue, Solid, Angular, and others. It includes Query (async data), Router and Start (routing and a full-stack framework), Table, Form, Virtual, Pacer, and Hotkeys, among others.
It's a good fit when you want typed, unstyled pieces you can combine to your liking, instead of a closed framework.
uses: Handling caching, retries, and loading states for your API calls with Query.
Building a custom data table with sorting, filtering, and pagination using Table.
Setting up typed routes in a React or Solid app with Router, or moving to a full-stack app with Start.
caveats: They're headless pieces: they don't ship visual components, so the design is up to you.
Several libraries are still in beta or alpha (DB, Pacer, Hotkeys, Store, Intent, Devtools, CLI), so their APIs may change.
Each library has its own documentation and adapters; check that one exists for your framework before adopting it.
pricingNote: Open-source libraries under the MIT license; paid enterprise support is available as a separate service.
idealFor: Frontend developers who prefer headless, typed libraries over a closed framework.
